dead_ends.hypothesis: unittest-parallel module-level execution is safe for all small legacy suites
dead_ends.outcome: Rejected: module-level parallelism across app test modules races shared import-time Frappe test doubles; fast-check python failed with 24 errors and 2 failures despite all tests running

goal: Own Developer Productivity, CI/CD Performance and Verification Engineering for Embryo: maximize verified engineering output per hour, increase defect detection, reduce verification latency/token consumption/deployment time, preserve correctness
grill_summary: User invoked /autoloop and supplied autonomous scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Assumptions: use default routing/model roster, human merge mode, cloud+deep review enabled. Single focused shard may touch verification infrastructure, CI workflows, dependency metadata, tests, and benchmark/research artifacts. Non-goals: no ERP business logic, financial calculations, backend transaction processing, native Rust workspace, or competing orchestration framework. Measured baseline: local fast-check 9.46-9.66s with Python unittest discovery dominating (tools suite 6.02-6.47s sequential vs 3.52-3.70s using unittest-parallel class-level j=4); GitHub main CI 30s total, 7s fast-check, 12s dependency/Knip setup; zizmor 1.33.1 scans workflows in 0.16s and reported 19 baseline findings (16 unpinned actions, 2 credential persistence, 1 intentional issue_comment trigger). Implement only measured high-ROI improvements: parallel unittest execution through existing unittest-parallel, zizmor workflow security gate with explicit justified exception, dependency caching/de-duplication in CI, and evidence documentation.
